summary: Second-response title recovery uses joint title-visible budgets and case-insensitive protected occurrences without weakening admission.
invariants: At most two calls. Only ordinary dynamic titles may shorten; fixed/source/header chrome and non-target text stay unchanged.
QID/role/CSS/geometry/font/structure stay unchanged; numbers, named tokens, negations and qualifiers remain protected.
Joint budget=min(title cap,visible cap-non-title text), less fixed titles; longest eligible title reduces first.
Named-token counts compare case-insensitively; deletion/replacement/addition stay rejected. Full semantic equivalence is not mechanically guaranteed.
Diagnostics contain bounded classes/counts/salted digests only; raw text, QIDs, tokens and salts are never persisted.
forbidden: Third author call, weaker caps, role changes or local title truncation.
Source/fixed text, font or geometry changes.
Raw rejected HTML, text, QIDs, token values, diagnostic salts or credentials in persisted diagnostics.
